title: pattern:00-KERNEL-AXIOMS — install K-1..K-12 axiom file
description: Copy assets/cc-axioms.md into the project's CONTRIBUTING.md (or AGENTS.md) under a 'Kernel Axioms' header. Required by every downstream gauntlet bead.

title: pattern:10-REFERENCE-PINNING — write <reference>_version_contract.toml
description: Render assets/version-contract-template.toml into docs/contracts/<reference>_version_contract.toml with the exact pinned reference version. Reference scope-decider subagent.

title: pattern:15-ENGINE-IDENTITY — define SUBJECT/REFERENCE identity constants
description: Add SUBJECT_IDENTITY_LABEL + REFERENCE_IDENTITY_LABEL constants to crates/<port>-harness/src/oracle.rs. Assert distinct at the comparator boundary.

title: pattern:20-ORACLE-PREFLIGHT-DOCTOR — author preflight check
description: Render the per-class oracle_preflight_doctor.rs per references/tooling/ORACLE-TOOLCHAIN.md. Emits {certifying: bool, aggregate_outcome: green|yellow|red, failures, remediation}. Runs at the top of every parity/certification lane.

title: pattern:30-DIFFERENTIAL-V2-ENVELOPE — write ExecutionEnvelope struct
description: crates/<port>-harness/src/differential_v2.rs with ExecutionEnvelope struct + artifact_id() function. Invariant: artifact_id = SHA-256 of canonical JSON excluding run_id.

title: pattern:05-SUBJECT-ORACLE-COMPARATOR — write the 30-line scenario() template
description: Verbatim per assets/integration-test-templates/<class>_oracle_e2e.rs. Both-error = agreement (message text irrelevant); one-error-one-OK = hard failure.

title: pattern:40-METAMORPHIC-TRANSFORMS — author metamorphic.rs
description: 4 TransformFamilies + EquivalenceExpectation enum + MismatchClassification triage + SeedContract (derive_entry_seed; never rand::random()). CI fails only on TrueDivergence.

title: pattern:45-MISMATCH-MINIMIZER — author mismatch_minimizer.rs
description: Delta-debug binary partition + schema-preservation guard + MismatchSignature for dedup. Per-class schema-preservation rule.

title: pattern:25-FIXTURE-ROOT-CONTRACT — write FixtureRootContract
description: Manifest SHA-256 + cardinality floors + hash-locked roots + included extensions. Makes fixture selection part of the evidence; prevents green-on-different-corpus.

title: pattern:90-FAILURE-BUNDLE — author FailureBundle v1.0.0
description: Every E2E failure produces a FailureBundle with first-divergence jsonptr at /failure/first_divergence + seed + schedule_fp + repro_command + state snapshots + environment fingerprint.

title: pattern:60-FAULT-VFS — declarative FaultSpec + F-1..F-8 adoption
description: FaultKind enum + FaultSpec + DEFAULT_FAULT_SEED + named profiles with expected_behavior.invariants_preserved. F-1..F-8 adoption checklist per references/patterns/60-FAULT-VFS.md.

title: pattern:95-FIRST-FAILURE-EXPLAINER — wire CI first-divergence + replay + playbook
description: Every CI failure surfaces: first divergence (jsonptr-deref'd), root-cause domain, replay command, RemediationPlaybook, artifact hash table. ROI compounds with every subsequent failure.

title: pattern:65-CRASH-BOUNDARIES — name + arm per-class boundaries
description: Per project class: SQL=8 WAL boundaries, RESP=6+ AOF/RDB, ML=5 checkpoint+2 distributed, HTTP=5 request-lifecycle. arm_crash_boundary(B) hook + recovery_verifier.

title: pattern:70-E-PROCESSES — install per-invariant e-process monitor
description: 5-10 project-defining invariants × hardware (p₀=1e-9, λ=0.999, α=1e-6) or software (p₀=1e-6, λ=0.9, α=0.001) calibration. Global e-value via arithmetic mean. Ville-bounded rejection.

title: pattern:125-COMPREHENSIVE-BENCH — author skeleton with 6 timing constants
description: WARMUP_ITERS=2, MIN_ITERS=3, MAX_ITERS=10, TARGET_DURATION=5s + workload-size vector + concurrency vector. measure() + measure_with_teardown() with teardown OUTSIDE timed window. JSON v3 self-describing.

title: pattern:155-BENCH-HISTORY-RATCHET — commit .bench-history/<bench>.latest.json
description: Gate thresholds: primary -3%, geomean -5%, per-category -10%, p90 -15%, throughput -5%. Both gates (focused + broad) must move in the same run window.

title: pattern:145-HOT-PATH-COUNTERS — instrument HotPathProfileSnapshot per class
description: Per project class, install the counter set from §23.6 row (e.g., SQL = prepared_lookup_time_ns, begin_setup_time_ns, etc.; RESP = resp_parse_time_ns, dict_probe_count, etc.).

title: pattern:75-BAYESIAN-CONFORMAL-SCORE — score_engine.rs with truncate_score
description: Beta posterior per category × pass rate; distribution-free conformal band; release uses LOWER bound. truncate_score to 6 decimal places for cross-platform reproducibility (x86 vs ARM vs WASM differ at LSB).

title: pattern:160-MT8-ATTRIBUTION — every kept perf win cites ≥0.1% MT8 frame
description: Profile under 8-thread multi-writer load. Surface only frames ≥0.1% self-time (below = micro-lever trap). Productive sweet spot 0.1-1.0%.

title: pattern:105-FEATURE-UNIVERSE — author parity_taxonomy.rs
description: Feature { id: F-{CATEGORY}-{SEQ}, title, weight, status, exclusion_rationale }. Three loader-enforced invariants: sum(weights)==1.0 per category; truncate_score determinism; deterministic iteration by FeatureId.

title: pattern:155-BENCH-HISTORY-RATCHET — wire apply-ratchet.sh in CI
description: reports/ratchet_state.json monotonic-update gating. apply-ratchet.sh emits Allow|Block|Quarantine|Waiver. Wired as CI gate via assets/github-workflows/parity-score-ratchet.yml.

title: pattern:120-VERIFICATION-CONTRACT — wire bead-close gating
description: verification_contract_enforcement.rs. Classifications: pass | fail-missing-evidence | fail-invalid-references | fail-mixed × base gate {allowed | blocked-by-base-gate | blocked-by-contract | blocked-by-both}. Separates 'code is wrong' from 'evidence link is wrong'.

title: pattern:180-NEGATIVE-LEDGER — seed three ledgers + AGENTS.md mandate
description: Seed docs/progress/perf-negative-results.md, conformance-negative-results.md, surface-deferrals.md with verbatim FrankenSQLite preamble. Install AGENTS.md mandate paragraph from assets/agents-md-mandate-paragraph.md with project-class failure-term list.
